content: EntropicMem is a standalone SQLite-based memory engine with FTS5 full-text search
The memory engine supports temporal decay scoring for fact relevance over time
Facts are stored with domain classification including Knowledge, Infrastructure, and Projects
The recall method uses BM25 ranking from SQLite FTS5 for relevance scoring
Recall with relevance combines FTS5 rank with temporal decay and reinforcement boosting
Vector embeddings are supported via sentence-transformers for semantic similarity search

Knowledge triples encode subject-predicate-object relationships with confidence scores
The vault system projects facts into Markdown notes with wikilink edges
